_about: Third-party asset packs for Fogwright. fetch.py downloads them from their itch.io pages into a folder outside the repo. 'repo' says whether the files may be committed to this public repository: CC0 packs may; packs that forbid redistribution may only ship inside the game (with any credit they require).

packs.name: Universal Animation Library
packs.note: Standard (free) version; in assets/animations/quaternius

packs.name: Universal Animation Library 2
packs.note: Standard (free) version; in assets/animations/quaternius

packs.name: Universal Base Characters
packs.note: Standard (free) version; in assets/characters/quaternius

packs.name: Lowpoly Medieval Weapons
packs.licence: CC0 1.0 (stated on the itch.io page; no licence file in the zip)

packs.name: Post-Apocalyptic World
packs.licence: Atomic Realm licence: commercial use and editing allowed; no repackaging, resale or redistribution, however modified; credit required (link https://atomicrealm.itch.io/)
packs.note: Free sample version; for the more modern, industrial elements

packs.name: Modular Village Pack
packs.note: Fertile Soil Productions; pairs with their Modular Terrain Pack

packs.name: Medieval Interior Asset Pack
packs.licence: No formal licence; the author (SOI) says 'free to use for any purpose' in the comments. Kept out of the repo to be safe.
packs.note: 38 PBR tavern interior assets with collision meshes

packs.name: Horror Texture Pack
packs.note: Screaming Brain Studios; grime, rust and rot for darker, Fog-touched places

packs.name: PSX Style Walls and Fences
packs.licence: CC0 (stated on the page; its textures are CC0 too)
packs.note: Deliberately low-resolution PS1 style

packs.name: Tiny Texture Pack 3
packs.note: Screaming Brain Studios; small tiling textures (stone, ground)

packs.name: Muzzle Flash VFX
packs.note: Binbun; for firearms

packs.name: Explosion FX
packs.note: Binbun; explosions, smoke

packs.name: Basic Motions FREE
packs.licence: No licence stated on the page; the author (Kevin Iglesias) asks for credit as a link to www.keviniglesias.com. Kept out of the repo.
packs.note: Extra motions, e.g. for NPCs

packs.name: Western Props Pack
packs.licence: Dev Assets (Brackeys) guidelines: free for commercial and non-commercial use, no credit needed; may only be distributed as part of a game, never as raw files. Kept out of the repo.
packs.note: Free tier; low poly, hand-painted, one atlas texture

packs.name: Fantasy Frost Environment
packs.licence: Dev Assets (Brackeys) guidelines: free for commercial and non-commercial use, no credit needed; may only be distributed as part of a game, never as raw files. Kept out of the repo.
packs.note: Free tier; low poly, hand-painted, one atlas texture

packs.name: Mayan Temple
packs.licence: Dev Assets (Brackeys) guidelines: free for commercial and non-commercial use, no credit needed; may only be distributed as part of a game, never as raw files. Kept out of the repo.
packs.note: Free tier; low poly, hand-painted, one atlas texture

packs.name: Steampunk Turret Pack
packs.note: 37 animated steampunk turrets (FBX, OBJ, Blend). Downloads from a shared Google Drive folder, which refuses scripted downloads: fetch it in a browser.

packs.name: Medieval Village Pack
packs.note: 44 animated models; older than the MegaKit. Downloads from a shared Google Drive folder, which refuses scripted downloads: fetch it in a browser.

packs.name: Animated Mech Pack
packs.note: 4 animated mechs, glTF included; to rework toward steampunk. Downloads from a shared Google Drive folder, which refuses scripted downloads: fetch it in a browser.

packs.name: Free Modular Low Poly Dungeon Pack (RGS_Dev)
packs.note: Walls, doors, floors, stairs, traps, chests, props; separated by material. Saved for later (dungeons and Breaches); not downloaded yet

packs.name: Temple Modular Collection (Fertile Soil Productions)
packs.note: Modular temple and palace pieces; saved for later (Aldrath's plaza, shrines). Not downloaded yet

packs.name: Free Stylized Food (NewLua Studios)
packs.licence: Free for games incl. commercial, no credit required; no named licence (not stated as CC0)
packs.note: Food props (taverns, markets, kitchens); keep out of the public repo until the licence is confirmed redistributable. Not downloaded yet

packs.name: Hit FX (Binbun)
packs.note: Godot hit and impact effects; the free version has 6 presets, the full pack is paid. Saved for combat

packs.name: Flame FX (Binbun)
packs.note: Godot flame effects (12 styles in the full pack); free version available. For forges, hearths, torches and the burning of Farhallow

packs.name: Low Poly Medieval Weapons (Anker's Assets)
packs.note: Medieval weapons and siege engines; candidates for the Wayfolk common iron set. Not downloaded yet

packs.name: Magic Projectiles VFX (Binbun)
packs.note: Godot spell projectiles; free version. For gods' magic and caster foci

packs.name: Magic Orb VFX (Binbun)
packs.licence: CC0 1.0 (the paid pack; the demo version is not covered)
packs.note: Paid ($2.99 on sale until 2 Dec 2026, normally more); only the paid files are CC0

packs.name: Fire VFX (Binbun)
packs.note: Paid ($2.99 on sale until 2 Dec 2026, normally $5.99): 30 Godot fire effects (flames, fireballs, ground fire, candle flame). Overlaps Flame FX; pick one

packs.name: Wooden Docks (loafbrr)
packs.note: Godot-ready docks and a dock house: Farhallow's pier and Hollin's Cross harbour

packs.name: Ceylon Blocks (bukkbeek)
packs.licence: Not stated on the page (only '(c) bukkbeek'); a free version exists
packs.note: Sri Lankan monastery and tropical plant modules, stupas, statues; check the licence file in the download before any use

packs.name: Human Villager / Crafting Animations FREE (Kevin Iglesias)
packs.licence: Kevin Iglesias asset terms: use in games, credit appreciated; not redistributable as files
packs.note: Idle, farming with plow, fishing (throw, wait, fight, pull), gathering, hammering, mining: villagers at work. Humanoid; needs retargeting to the Quaternius rig

packs.name: Fences Walls PSX/PS1 (yugg0)
packs.licence: Free for personal and commercial games and to modify; may not be claimed or distributed under your own name (no standard licence named)
packs.note: PSX-style walls and fences with PNG textures. Not for the public repo; would need a private, uncommitted asset folder for builds

packs.name: Low Poly Fence Pack (Ami Polygon)
packs.licence: Free for personal and commercial games, modifiable, credit appreciated; no reselling or redistributing the files
packs.note: Stylized low-poly fences in three colours (FBX, GLB). Not for the public repo; Farhallow uses our own dry-stone wall, wattle hurdle and the kit's rail fence for now

packs.name: Low Poly Viking Ship (Glory Asset)
packs.licence: Free for any purpose, personal or commercial, no credit; credits Quaternius as the maker (likely CC0, not stated)
packs.note: OBJ/FBX longship. Keep out of the public repo until the licence is confirmed as CC0 (if it is Quaternius's, it is)

packs.name: Stylized Sailboat (noremi111)
packs.licence: Not stated on the page; check the download for a licence file
packs.note: A small brig with swappable sail and flag textures (.blend, .fbx): a candidate for the last ship
